data.name: Barkaat
data.gender_notes: Barkaat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'barka', meaning 'blessing' or 'favor'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (SWT) showers His blessings upon those who are named Barkaat. The name Barkaat carries the meaning “Blessing, Favor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barkaat usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name associated with blessings from Allah (SWT).
data.etymology: Barkaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barkaat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
